Still waiting on you for: (1) signoff on the BUG-2569 sketch (on the spec; it reuses the reader #3983 adds, so I will stack it on #3983); (2) the scoped re-review of #3981 at c901aa5143a.

One thing for the operator: /home/joe/ai/aida/.git/config.lock is a stale zero-byte lock dated Nov 13 21:31. Every git config write in the repository fails while it exists (branch upstream tracking; it interrupted one of my branch switches). I did not remove it because it is not mine; if no git process owns it, it should be deleted.

Next for me: BUG-2555.
